name: Video Intercom
description: Video calls between kiosks, with a preview of your own camera before you pick who to call. Each kiosk shows the other kiosk's live camera with two-way hands-free voice. The person being called sees the caller while it rings. Kiosks talk directly on your local network: no server, cloud or Home Assistant in between. Kiosks with the same key find each other on the network. Needs RTSP streaming on in Camera settings on every kiosk.
author: ersaber

settings.title: Intercom key
settings.description: A long random key of at least 16 characters, the same on every kiosk; a password manager can make one. A shorter key turns calls off. Kiosks with the same key find each other; others cannot call this one.

settings.title: This kiosk's name
settings.description: Shown on the other kiosk when this one calls. Empty uses the device name.

settings.title: Extra kiosks
settings.description: Optional. Kiosks with this plugin and the same key are found on the network by themselves. Add one here only if it is not found, such as on another subnet.

fields.title: IP address
fields.description: Its IP address, such as 192.168.1.69. Add :port if it listens on another port.

settings.title: Answer mode
settings.description: Ring shows the caller's picture with Answer and Decline. Answer automatically opens the call after 3 seconds, which gives anyone with the key this kiosk's audio and video without anyone touching the screen.

settings.title: Show my camera during calls
settings.description: A small picture of this kiosk's own camera in the corner of the call.

settings.title: End call with
settings.description: Kiosk Satellite's own gestures do not work over the call screen, so it has its own: a double tap or a long press anywhere on the picture ends the call.

settings.title: Hang up with button
settings.description: A hardware button that ends a call. It still changes the volume unless Disable volume buttons is on in Kiosk Mode.

settings.title: Call volume
settings.description: How loud the other kiosk's voice plays here.

settings.title: Microphone
settings.description: Automatic uses Voice communication first, where echo cancelling works best. If the other side hears nothing, try another.

settings.title: Pause the wake word during calls
Wake word paused by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin: set while a call has the wake word muted, so the next start unmutes it if the call was cut off.

settings.title: RTSP port
settings.description: The other kiosks' camera stream port: 8080 when Camera streaming uses ONVIF, 8554 for RTSP. If this one is refused, the plugin tries the other.

settings.title: RTSP username
settings.description: The camera streaming login, if one is set in Kiosk Satellite's camera streaming settings. Setting one is recommended, since without it anyone on the network can watch the camera. Use the same login on every kiosk.

settings.title: Call port
settings.description: This kiosk listens for calls here. Keep it the same on every kiosk.
